findings.title: Client-onboarding mutations run without any `requirePermission` gate
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: routes/client-onboarding-command-center.ts requirePermission on every mutation (:137,154,177,200,247); 403 regression coverage in the route suite.

findings.title: `profiles.is_super_admin` is user-writable under the RLS self-update policy (forgeable super-admin flag)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: supabase/migrations/5302437_protect_is_super_admin.sql installs a BEFORE UPDATE trigger on public.profiles that raises for authenticated/anon JWT roles when is_super_admin changes; service_role and direct SQL are unaffected.

findings.title: `PLATFORM_ADMIN_KEYS` (org traversal) and `ADMIN_BYPASS_KEYS` (permission bypass) are inconsistent trust sets
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: CROSS_TENANT_KEYS vs ELEVATED_TENANT_KEYS split in @mct/sdk/role-keys; API re-exports via lib/roles.ts; catalog-parity.test.ts asserts parity with 5302128.

findings.title: RLS is not a database backstop on API requests (service-role is the default client)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: rls-startup-check.ts:40-46 refuses prod boot on an empty read allow-list; getScopedClient (services/supabase.ts:197-225) still returns the service-role client for modules not listed in RLS_READS/WRITES_ENABLED and meters the bypass. Residual: deployed allow-list values and write coverage remain operator-side / per-module.

findings.title: Write and state-transition actions gated by `view` permissions (action mismatch)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: a mutating-verb scan finds a single remaining view-gated mutation - apps/api/src/routes/ai.ts:217 POST /triage/analyze uses requirePermission('ai','view') (documented triage exception). Everything else now uses create/edit/delete/manage.

findings.title: Webhook endpoint and delivery reads are available to any org member (not manage-gated)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: routes/webhook-management.ts gates reads with requirePermission('webhooks','view') (:103 list, :125 dead-letters, :348 by-id, :508 deliveries) and mutations with 'webhooks','manage'.

findings.title: API keys store `expires_at` but nothing enforces or prunes expiry
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: expired keys fail closed in middleware/api-key.ts:84-88 and are pruned by the scheduled api-key-prune task (worker/tasks/index.ts:51, schedule-config.ts:50; api-key-prune.test.ts).

findings.title: Webhook signing secrets are stored plaintext with no rotation or expiry
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: routes/webhook-management.ts:35-52 encrypts signing secrets at rest (AES-256-GCM via lib/field-encryption), masks them on read (:28-31,77-78) and records secret_expires_at rotation metadata (:52,369; migration 5302441).

findings.title: Profiles are enumerable by email/id for any authenticated user
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: GET /profiles?email=/?ids= still enumerates profiles for any authenticated user (routes/profiles.ts:62-92) but RLS restricts selects to self/same-org/super-admin (5302026:1006-1016) and decryptProfileRow strips the encrypted_pii ciphertext from responses. Residual: the directory query remains ungated by a users/profiles permission.

findings.title: API-key `permissions` are decorative: keys act with the creator's full permissions and the column is never enforced
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: middleware/permissions.ts:73-79 caps every key request to the stored scope list before creator-side resolution; api-keys.ts:43 gates the list route with api-keys:view.

findings.title: Client-side permission hiding is UI-only for several module actions
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: server enforcement is broad and catalog-linted, and route-authorization-guard.test.ts covers router mounts; but there is still no per-route permission-guard coverage gate, and ACM-P3-008 (new) shows reads in final/* / registerCrud where UI hiding is the only 'view' control.

findings.title: No catalog-lint: referenced permission keys are not checked against the `permissions` table
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: scripts/ci/check-permission-catalog.sh runs scripts/check-permission-catalog.mjs over requirePermission literals, live RLS user_has_permission predicates and registerCrud module keys, with a negative fixture; wired in .github/actions/unit-tests/action.yml:103-108.

findings.title: Public route surface is broad and has no single documented inventory
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: docs/PUBLIC_ROUTES.md is generated from the auth:false OpenAPI RouteDefs and CI runs `node scripts/public-route-inventory.mjs --check` (.github/actions/unit-tests/action.yml:113-117).

findings.title: `GET /roles/:id` and `GET /me/permissions` are readable without an admin gate
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: routes/roles.ts:67 GET /roles/:id now requireAdmin; GET /me/permissions is self-scoped by design (routes/me.ts:18 resolves only req.authUser.userId).

findings.title: RLS policies reference `manage` permissions that no role holds (dead predicates)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: supabase/migrations/5302459_dead_rls_permission_predicates.sql adds catalog rows for every historical predicate key (tickets:comment/manage, documents:manage/upload, projects:manage, contracts:*, appointments:*, onboarding:update) and the catalog guard is clean.

findings.title: `GET /api-keys` lists org keys for any org member (no `api-keys:view` gate)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: routes/api-keys.ts:43 GET / now requires requirePermission('api-keys','view'); api-keys-list-gate.test.ts covers the denial.

findings.title: AI copilot endpoints have no permission gate (any org member can run summarization and reply drafts)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd04023: routes/ai.ts gates copilot routes - ai:view on triage list (:346-348), drafts list/detail (:537,562); ai:create on generate/drafts (:418-420,515); ai:edit on review (:578); ai-copilot-permission-gate.test.ts.

findings.title: ACM-P3-008
findings.note: NEW at 7dd04023: registerCrud reads and final/* module routes have no requirePermission gate. apps/api/src/routes/final/crud.ts:33-59 lists rows and :88-103 fetches by id with only the router-level requireAuth+requireOrgAccess (final.ts:20-21); final/sharepoint.ts:7, final/backups.ts:7,22, final/budgets.ts:7, final/time-entries.ts:11, routes/sla.ts:13 and the POST /procurement/compare compute endpoint (final/procurement.ts:8, runs on getSupabaseAdmin) are equally ungated. The permission catalog defines view actions for these modules (supabase/migrations/5302118_permission_matrix_full_catalog.sql:182-185), so any approved org member - including client roles with no view grant - can read them for their own org. No cross-tenant path (requireOrgAccess pins/injects the org), hence P3.
